desc.zh: 我们不只是提供建议，我们交付可运行的代码。每一个战略都以可验证的工程成果为终点。
desc.en: We don't just advise — we deliver working code. Every strategy ends with verifiable engineering outcomes.

desc.zh: 我们相信最好的想法可以来自任何地方。我们的团队横跨 14 个城市，说 15 种以上的语言。
desc.en: We believe the best ideas can come from anywhere. Our team spans 14 cities and speaks 15+ languages.

desc.zh: 衡量我们成功的最终标准是客户团队能否独立前行。我们构建能力，而非依赖。
desc.en: The ultimate measure of our success is whether the client team can move forward independently. We build capability, not dependency.

desc.zh: 在 AI 时代，持续学习不是福利而是工作要求。我们投入 15% 的工作时间用于学习和知识分享。
desc.en: In the AI era, continuous learning is not a perk but a job requirement. We invest 15% of working time in learning and knowledge sharing.

desc.zh: 与招聘团队进行非正式沟通，了解你的背景和兴趣。
desc.en: Informal conversation with our recruiting team to understand your background and interests.

desc.en: Depending on the role, you'll work through a technical design or business case analysis.

desc.zh: 与未来的同事和跨职能领导进行深入对话，探讨你的工作方式和价值观匹配。
desc.en: Deep conversations with future colleagues and cross-functional leaders about your working style and values alignment.

desc.zh: 我们通常在 48 小时内给出反馈。欢迎你在任何阶段提出疑问。
desc.en: We typically provide feedback within 48 hours. You're welcome to raise questions at any stage.
